name: Bride And Bridegroom
overview: The imagery of the bride and bridegroom in Scripture vividly portrays the joyful and sacred relationship between Christ and His Church. Isaiah 61:10 illustrates the believer adorned in righteousness as a bride is with her jewels, while the parable in Matthew 25 emphasizes readiness to meet the coming bridegroom. John 3:29 highlights the intimate joy of the bridegroom’s friend, reflecting the delight in Christ’s voice. Finally, Revelation 19 and 21 depict the ultimate union of the Lamb and His prepared bride, symbolizing the holy city, New Jerusalem, beautifully prepared for eternal fellowship.
